pr_body:
As @fcofdez had [cleverly remarked](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/92588/files#r1088721302), the wait in this test was too harsh in general. Simply waiting for the latches of the cancelled children to complete is also enough.

Also adding @pxsalehi as reviewer in case you can better (or faster) review it.

Fixes #94989
pr_comment:
Hi, the latest CI revealed the basic bug of the test: I had made the cancellable task spinning, which in some cases resulted in all the generic thread pool being saturated, and not allowing the new cancellation requests to be done. I could not easily reproduce it on my laptop because I have many cores (I just caught it once), but it happens more regularly in the CI it seems. So I finally amended the PR to make the tasks not spinning: they are simply re-scheduled every 10ms until cancelled. This leaves "space" for the cancellation requests to be executed.

Feel free to review. cc @DaveCTurner , @pxsalehi

review_comment: Hi! I do not think it matters. They both kind of depend on cancellations having finished (and thus both have timed waits), but they check different stuff.
